litellm.RateLimitError: RateLimitError: OpenAIException - Monthly usage limit reached. Resets in 16hr 32min. To continue using this model now, enable usage from your available balance: https://opencode.ai/workspace/<SCRUBBED:opencode-workspace-id>/go. Received Model Group=claude-opencode-go-grok-4.5
Available Model Group Fallbacks=None

provenance: captured 2026-07-27 through the operator's own proxy, one call to claude-opencode-go-grok-4.5 after the monthly plan ran out. The workspace id was scrubbed by name; it is an account identifier, not a credential.
note: The condition this whole feature exists for, and classify read it wrong. 'quota' does not appear, so the quota rule missed it; 'Resets in 16hr 32min' matched neither reset-time pattern. It fell through to the bare-429 rule as rate_limited with no reset, which is inconclusive and changes nothing -- so an Offering that could not answer for 16 hours stayed in the Generated Config. expected_reset_at is CAPTURE_NOW plus 16hr 32min, the harness's own clock.
